name: gist
description: Manual session-gist writer — checkpoint a Claude Code session as a dated markdown gist in the repo's docs/sessions/. Frontmatter is interoperable with the vault-context auto-gist pipeline (same session_id + shape + filename schema), so /gist and the scheduled vault-context jobs don't produce duplicates. (Formerly the `recap` plugin; renamed to avoid Claude Code's built-in /recap.)
